flows:

Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First, press Tab twice in the page before evaluating focusability.
Continue using Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the target.
check the Search FDIC.gov textbox is in sequential keyboard focus order.
Focus it with Tab and verify it accepts text.
Prefer public BankFind or Resources links if present; stop before authenticated services.
